_comment: Required openclaw.json additions after installing this plugin.
1. models.providers — registers 'claude-agent-sdk' as an HTTP provider.
OpenClaw routes all agent requests to the local http-server (port 18791).
localService auto-starts start-http-server when the first request arrives.
2. agents.defaults.model — set all agents to use the HTTP provider.
Replace 'claude-sonnet-4-6' with whichever model you have access to.
The CLI backend (registerCliBackend in index.mjs) is intentionally disabled.
All channels (Discord, voice, webchat, cron) go through the HTTP provider.
